It is believed that the name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'mrun', which means 'to sprout', 'to grow' or 'to bud'. This name is often associated with the god Vayu, the Hindu god of wind. According to Hindu mythology, Vayu is believed to be the giver of life and the sustainer of all living beings. The name 'Mrunal' is also believed to be derived from the Sanskrit word 'mruna', which means 'to be still', 'to be calm'. This name is often given to babies born under the star sign of Leo or Virgo.
